name: Left Lane Must Turn Left
spec: white vertical rectangle with black legend LEFT LANE MUST TURN LEFT and a left arrow
meaning: Vehicles in this lane must turn left.

snippets.back: A LEFT LANE MUST TURN LEFT sign means traffic in the left lane has to turn left at the intersection ahead.
A flashing yellow left arrow permits a cautious left turn only after yielding to opposing traffic and pedestrians.
Flashing yellow light and flashing yellow arrow differ: the plain flashing light warns of a hazard, while the flashing arrow permits a left turn only after yielding to oncoming traffic and walkers.
A flashing yellow left-turn arrow permits the left turn only after yielding to pedestrians and oncoming vehicles; opposing traffic still has green.
The handbook's T-intersection warning describes a junction where the driver must turn left or right.
A Left Turn Yield on Green sign permits a left turn only after yielding to approaching traffic.
Regulatory examples in the manual include signs that ban right turns, left turns, U-turns or all turns, plus Left Turn Only, Do Not Enter, Wrong Way, No Parking, No Turn on Red and Do Not Pass.
Do not pass when oncoming traffic is too close, when you cannot see clearly ahead, or when the three-lane center lane is marked left turn only.
